meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把数据转化为有说服力的故事，包括构建叙事结构、选择可视化方式、撰写标题和过渡语，并生成演示文稿模板。
howto.when: 当你需要向高管、投资者或非技术受众展示数据分析结果，或制作季度业务报告、数据驱动报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我用问题-解决方案框架分析客户流失数据。
为Q4业绩制作一个趋势故事，包含时间线和对比表格。
say.note: Claude 会输出从起点到转变再到关键洞察的叙事流程。

say.text: 写一个市场机会对比故事，比较EMEA和APAC。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含加权评分矩阵和推荐方案的对比分析。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you transform data into compelling narratives by structuring stories, selecting visualizations, writing headlines and transitions, and generating presentation templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when presenting analytics to executives, investors, or non-technical audiences, or when creating quarterly business reviews or data-driven reports.

say_en.text: Help me analyze customer churn data using the problem-solution framework.
Create a trend story for Q4 performance with timeline and comparison table.
Write a comparison story for market opportunity between EMEA and APAC.
